summary.en-US: Marks YouTube videos you have already watched. Community fork of Watchmarker; all data stays in your browser.

description.en-US:
Watchmarker Redo for YouTube marks the videos you have already watched, directly on YouTube's pages, without depending on YouTube's own watch history.

This is a community fork of [Watchmarker for Youtube](https://github.com/sniklaus/youtube-watchmarker), based on version 5.1.0 and updated for Firefox's Manifest V3 event pages. It fixes the intermittent failure that stopped marking videos until the extension was disabled and re-enabled, restores missing bundled assets, adds Shorts support, and keeps working after Firefox suspends the background page.

All data stays in your browser: the extension uses local storage and IndexedDB, has no telemetry, no analytics, no ads and no server of its own. It only contacts youtube.com and m.youtube.com using your existing session, as the original extension does. See the privacy policy for details.

Source code, issues and release notes: https://github.com/Jalkhov/youtube-watchmarker-redo

Licensed under GPL-3.0. Not affiliated with YouTube, Google, or the original author.

release_notes.en-US:
First stable release of the community fork.

- Fixed the intermittent failure that stopped marking videos until the extension was disabled and re-enabled.
- Background listeners are registered synchronously and IndexedDB opens lazily, so events are not lost when Firefox suspends the event page.
- The options page reconnects its ports and reports interrupted requests instead of hanging.
- The content script retries lookups that arrive while the background is waking up.
- Fixed a Firefox-specific bug where a successful lookup was treated as an error because runtime.lastError is null.
- Restored the bundled idb, jQuery, Moment, Bootstrap, FontAwesome and download.js assets.
- Added a selector for YouTube Shorts.
- The synchronization alarm is no longer reset on every background start.
- Removed the unused webRequestBlocking permission.
- Declared no data collection.

version.approval_notes: Community fork of Watchmarker for Youtube (GPL-3.0), based on the 5.1.0 source. No remote code, no eval, no telemetry and no developer server. All data stays in local storage and IndexedDB; the extension only talks to youtube.com and m.youtube.com with the user's session. The bundled minified libraries (jQuery 3.7.1, Moment 2.30.1, Bootstrap 5.3.7, FontAwesome Free 6.6.0, download.js 4.21, idb 8.0.3) are unmodified upstream release builds; versions, licenses and official URLs are documented in THIRD_PARTY.md. Full human-readable source: https://github.com/Jalkhov/youtube-watchmarker-redo
